decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY adding the SK6812 LEDs to the complete 3.3V rail powered in standalone USB mode; no additional or corrected Event is required.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY setting the LED supply to 3.3V, removing the obsolete level-shifter part, disabling level shifting, and specifying direct ESP32 data drive.
Changing the SK6812 supply rail does not alter the main-board connector count, destinations, types, or pin inventory.
The LED supply and data-level decision does not change any panel control, input connector, GPIO mapping, or button behavior.
The boards remain chained in the same order and the main board still consumes incoming power and forwards both rails to the sensor board; only a local LED load moved to 3.3V.
Adding the LEDs as a downstream 3.3V load does not change the OR-ing method, participating power sources, or source-selection behavior.
The source decision does not change the configured 3.4V DCDC1 setpoint, its I2C configuration, or the compensated downstream 3.3V target.
The LED rail change does not alter any sensor-board input connector, sensor output connector, pinout, or connector count.
The source decision does not add, remove, or otherwise change the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The message changes LED supply and data-level handling but specifies no change to the 5V enable pin or any other ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The SK6812 supply and logic-level change is unrelated to I2C series-resistor value, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The LED becoming a downstream 3.3V load does not change the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology, battery input range, or general battery power path.
